note: Ship 9 (SIGNAL_ROADMAP.md) — Divergence Detector. New function detectDivergences() finds swing pivots with K=2 lookback each side, then compares consecutive same-type pivots within 20 bars: price lower low + RSI higher low → bullish divergence; price higher high + RSI lower high → bearish. Classic Signal card gets a new Divergence row (◆ Bullish / ◆ Bearish, N bars ago). The ribbon field Fable designed for diamonds finally has a data source — bullish diamonds render emerald, bearish gold. Reasons array gets the same information as text so pattern context lives in the Why section too.
